bloques.titulo: In this case, the Commission is not in a position to make a statement on the basis of the above-mentioned information.
texto: In addition, it also presents a result at the end of a process. Do not always translate these adverbs as «at last»: see the context assessment.
In the first place, the Commission has been able to provide information on the implementation of the measures to be taken by the Commission.
The case was finally discovered after the investigation.

frases.ja: なんど も しっぱい した が、 やっと せいこう しました。
frases.es: Fracasé varias veces, pero por fin lo conseguí.
frases.en: I failed several times, but I finally got it.

frases.ja: ちょうさ の すえ、 ついに げんいん が わかりました。
frases.es: Tras la investigación, finalmente se descubrió la causa.
frases.en: After the investigation, the cause was finally discovered.
